description: Renders the sketch board to an image and returns it so you can SEE what's drawn — layout, arrows, handwriting-style strokes, sticky notes — not just data about it. Use this before answering any question about a sketch's contents, and cite the board when you do — `[[board:ID]]` alone on its own line embeds the sketch card in your reply.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_boards_view
title: View a Napkin sketch (rendered image)
